name: 02150 · Chelsea, MA
findings: ZIP 02150 (Chelsea) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02150 (Chelsea) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
